description: Game engine observability: game lifecycle, phase timing, event bus health, and move analytics

panels.description: Normal: < 50 active games (green). Watch for: sustained > 100 (red) may indicate stuck phases or games not finishing. Check next: Games Created/Finished Rate for flow balance.
panels.title: Active Games

panels.description: Normal: growing counter proportional to game activity. Watch for: counter stalling (bus stopped processing). Check next: Event Heartbeat for rate view.
panels.title: Total Events

panels.description: Normal: 0 errors (green). Watch for: any non-zero value (red) indicates handler failures. Check next: Event Bus Detail collapsed row for per-handler error breakdown.
panels.title: Handler Error Rate

panels.description: Normal: consistent median game duration. Watch for: rising median means games are getting slower. Check next: Game Duration P50/P95 in Decide for trend analysis.
panels.title: Game Duration P50

panels.description: Normal: created and finished rates roughly balanced. Watch for: created >> finished means games accumulating (stuck phases). Check next: Active Games stat for current count.
panels.title: Games Created/Finished Rate

panels.description: Normal: bus:move_executed (gray) dominates, headline events (gold/red) visible as thin bands. Watch for: any event type dropping to zero while others continue. Check next: Headline Frequency stats or Event Handler Latency in Decide.
panels.title: Game Event Heartbeat

panels.description: Normal: DEPLOY and ATTACK p95 highest; REINFORCE and CONQUER lowest. Watch for: a single phase spiking while others stay flat (phase-specific regression). Check next: Phase Duration Heatmap for distribution shape, Moves per Second by Phase in Decide.
panels.title: Phase × Latency p95

panels.description: Normal: dense band in low-seconds range (fast phases). Watch for: heat spreading to higher buckets over time. Check next: Phase × Latency p95 hero for per-phase breakdown.
panels.title: Phase Duration Heatmap

panels.description: Normal: concentrated distribution showing consistent game lengths. Watch for: bimodal distribution (fast + very slow games). Check next: Game Duration P50/P95 in Decide for percentile trends.
panels.title: Game Duration Heatmap

panels.description: Normal: deploy and attack phases are longest; reinforce is shortest. Watch for: P99 diverging from P50 (tail latency outliers), a single phase spiking while others stay flat. Check next: Game Duration P50/P95 in Decide.
panels.title: Phase Latency P50/P99

panels.description: Normal: captured and lost rates correlated with game activity; elimination is lower steady rate. Watch for: captured >> lost (map consolidation), sudden elimination spikes (many games ending). Check next: Headline Frequency sparklines below.
panels.title: Headline Event Rates

panels.description: Normal: steady rate proportional to active games. Watch for: rate dropping to zero (no map consolidation happening). Check next: Headline Event Rates timeseries for trend.
panels.title: Continent Captured

panels.description: Normal: low steady rate (eliminations are rare events). Watch for: sudden spikes (many games ending simultaneously). Check next: Game Duration Heatmap for game length distribution.
panels.title: Player Eliminated

panels.description: Normal: steady completions matching game creation rate. Watch for: rate dropping to zero while active games remain (stuck games). Check next: Active Games stat and Games Created/Finished Rate in Observe.
panels.title: Game Completed

panels.description: Normal: deploy most frequent, then attack, then reinforce/conquer. Watch for: a phase dropping to zero while others continue (phase blocked). Check next: Event Handler Latency for downstream processing speed.
panels.title: Moves per Second by Phase

panels.description: Normal: consistent P50 with P95 within 2-3x of P50. Watch for: P95 growing while P50 stays flat (subset of slow games). Check next: Phase × Latency p95 in Orient to identify which phase is slow.
panels.title: Game Duration P50/P95

panels.description: Normal: all handlers < 100ms p95. Watch for: individual handler p95 > 500ms (slow consumer bottleneck). Check next: Event Dispatch Duration for bus-level overhead.
panels.title: Event Handler Latency p95

panels.description: Normal: all event types dispatched < 50ms. Watch for: bus:move_executed dispatch exceeding 100ms (many handlers subscribed). Check next: Event Bus Detail collapsed row for throughput and errors.
panels.title: Event Dispatch Duration p95

panels.description: Normal: fanout=4 slightly higher than fanout=3 (one extra WS write). Watch for: fanout=4 p95 disproportionately higher than fanout=3 (non-linear cost scaling). Check next: System Health for WS connection pool and DB pool pressure.
panels.title: WS Fanout Cost

panels.description: Normal: bus:move_executed dominates throughput. Watch for: unexpected event type surges. Check next: Event Bus Events Total for cumulative count.
panels.title: Handler Throughput

panels.description: Normal: growing counter proportional to game activity. Watch for: counter stalling (bus stopped processing). Check next: Handler Throughput for rate view.
panels.title: Event Bus Events Total

panels.description: Normal: deploy highest, attack second, conquer/reinforce lower. Watch for: unusual ratios (few conquer relative to attack). Check next: Moves per Second by Phase for rate view.
panels.title: Total Moves by Phase

panels.description: Normal: move endpoints dominate game traffic. Watch for: unexpected routes or disproportionate error rates. Check next: System Health for full HTTP breakdown.
panels.title: Game HTTP Route Request Rate

panels.description: Normal: game creation, move execution, phase transitions. Watch for: error-level entries, panic recoveries. Check next: filter by Game ID using the $gameId variable above.
panels.title: Game Event Logs
